title: N. parisii infection of C. elegans
author: Emily Troemel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.waiface

steps.title: Prepare L4 Worms
steps.instruction: Pick 20 L4 worms for each strain to be tested onto 10 cm OP50/NGM plates.

steps.title: Generate L1 Worms
steps.instruction: Incubate L4 worms for 4 days at 20°C, then bleach the worms and hatch eggs overnight in M9 buffer.

steps.title: Prepare NGM Plates
steps.instruction: Remove 6 cm unseeded NGM plates from the cold room to allow them to reach room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Infection Mix
steps.instruction: Create a mixture of food and spores, then distribute into separate tubes for each strain to be tested.

substeps.instruction: Target 150 µl superfood and 1.5x10^6 spores per 6 cm plate.
Add 1200 L1 worms per 6 cm plate.
Add M9 as necessary to reach a total volume of 500 µl per plate.
If setting up replicates, create one master mix of food, spores, and worms before splitting between plates.

steps.title: Infect Worms
steps.instruction: Apply the infection mix to the NGM plates and allow them to dry.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl of the spores/food/worms mix to an unseeded 6 cm NGM plate.
Tilt the plate to spread the liquid over the entire surface area.
Dry the plates in the hood.
